description: The EV Charging Installation Technician qualification provides learners with the knowledge and skills to manage the complete lifecycle of EV charging infrastructure covering planning, installation, operation, and maintenance. The program includes training in EV science, relevant policies, digital tools like software based charging and GPS mapping, as well as site readiness and safety protocols. Participants will be equipped to lead teams, ensure efficient station operations, and support the growth of India s EV ecosystem. This Qualification will support EV industries, by providing skilled workers for management of EV charging infrastructure as Charging Station Supervisors. EV industry has rolled down several EV models in 2 Wheeler, 3 Wheeler and 4 Wheeler segments and have already put significant charging infrastructure in many Indian cities.
